description: 국토교통부_공사중인 시설물(교량) 목록 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국토교통부. 공사정보 및 현장번호, 시설물 종류, 시설물명, 시점-종점, 교량 연장, 교량폭, 상단공법 등 정보 제공. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 국토교통부. Its tags are 공사정보, 시설물정보, 교량정보, 교량공사, 현장관리. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-11-18 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
